title: What's Going on With Microsoft Stock? | MSFT Stock Deep Dive Part 1
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc opens a deep dive into Microsoft after a mixed quarter: cloud revenue accelerated while Windows OEM sales declined or worsened. Microsoft remains one of the big four alongside Amazon, Meta and Alphabet, and the only one he expects to be free-cash-flow positive in calendar 2027. The focus is Copilot adoption: the biggest Copilot update yet this quarter drove strong growth, with daily users up sharply year on year (the exact figure is garbled in the captions) and user satisfaction up nearly 20% quarter on quarter to an all-time high. He argues that if business users see more value, paying $5-10 more per month on a sub-$20 product is a significant uplift and a long runway. In healthcare, Microsoft automated 30 million patient encounters in the quarter, up 70% year on year, and he sees healthcare AI — not yet having had its ChatGPT moment — as a potential next catalyst for AI demand, alongside driverless cars, if data-centre capex peaks around 2029 as forecast. He also flags Nvidia's results around 20 November, which he will cover live for channel members. No explicit buy, sell or hold call is made in this part 1; it is a fundamentals update, so no call-event is recorded. Other tickers discussed: NVDA (results preview only).
